const r = await tools.exec_command({"cmd":"set -o pipefail
env LUA_PATH="$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/share/lua/5.1/?.lua;$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/share/lua/5.1/?/init.lua;;" LUA_CPATH="$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/lib/lua/5.1/?.so;;" "$TOME_LUAJIT" -e '
local files = {"mod-tome.lua", "tome-ashes-urhrok.lua", "tome-cults.lua", "tome-orcs.lua"}
local baseline = ".ai/task/repair-w62-20261001/baseline/"
local function load_catalog(path)
  local events, current = {}, nil
  local env = {}
  env.section = function(name)
    current = name
    events[#events + 1] = {kind = "section", name = name}
  end
  env.t = function(...)
    local args = {n = select("#", ...), ...}
    events[#events + 1] = {kind = "t", section = current, args = args}
  end
  setmetatable(env, {__index = _G})
  local chunk, err = loadfile(path)
  assert(chunk, err)
  setfenv(chunk, env)
  local ok, runerr = pcall(chunk)
  assert(ok, path .. ": " .. tostring(runerr))
  return events
end
local changed = 0
for _, file in ipairs(files) do
  local before = load_catalog(baseline .. file)
  local after = load_catalog(file)
  assert(#before == #after, file .. ": record count changed")
  for i = 1, #before do
    local a, b = before[i], after[i]
    assert(a.kind == b.kind, file .. ": record kind changed at " .. i)
    if a.kind == "section" then
      assert(a.name == b.name, file .. ": section changed at " .. i)
    else
      assert(a.section == b.section, file .. ": section association changed at " .. i)
      assert(a.args.n == b.args.n, file .. ": arg count changed at " .. i)
      local target_only = false
      for j = 1, a.args.n do
        if a.args[j] ~= b.args[j] then
          assert(j == 2 and not target_only, file .. ": non-target or multiple field change at " .. i)
          target_only = true
        end
      end
      if target_only then
        local fields = {file, a.section, a.args[1], a.args[2], b.args[2], a.args[3], tostring(a.args.n)}
        for _, value in ipairs(fields) do
          assert(type(value) == "string" and not value:find("[\t\r\n]"), file .. ": unsafe validation field")
        end
        io.write("CHANGE\t", table.concat(fields, "\t"), "\n")
        changed = changed + 1
      end
    end
  end
end
io.write("LUA_SUMMARY\t", tostring(#files), "\t", tostring(changed), "\n")
' | python3 -c '
import json, sys
from pathlib import Path
task = Path(".ai/task/repair-w62-20261001")
items = json.loads((task / "WORKSET.json").read_text())["items"]
envelope = json.loads((task / "CONTEXTUAL-ENVELOPE-f1a2.json").read_text())
frozen = {x["revision_key"]: x for x in envelope["payload"]["translation_snapshot"]}
expected = {}
for item in items:
    key = (item["normalized_path"], item["section"], item["source"], item["source_tag"])
    assert key not in expected, key
    expected[key] = item
actual = {}
summary = None
for raw in sys.stdin:
    parts = raw.rstrip("\n").split("\t")
    if parts[0] == "CHANGE":
        assert len(parts) == 8, parts
        _, file, section, source, old, new, tag, argc = parts
        key = (file, section, source, tag)
        assert key not in actual, key
        actual[key] = (old, new, argc)
    elif parts[0] == "LUA_SUMMARY":
        summary = (int(parts[1]), int(parts[2]))
    else:
        raise AssertionError(parts)
assert summary == (4, 53), summary
assert set(actual) == set(expected), (set(expected)-set(actual), set(actual)-set(expected))
round_changes = []
for key, item in expected.items():
    old, new, argc = actual[key]
    ident = item["entry_revision_identity"]
    assert old == item["target_preimage"], ident
    assert item["args_order"] is None and argc == "3", ident
    snap = frozen[ident]
    assert snap["source"] == item["source"], ident
    if new != snap["target"]:
        round_changes.append((ident, snap["target"], new))
assert round_changes == [("f34d093d2aa9beffde4d2d4b3e6c62e27ddcf230b5cb1f6ed68a600245a96e14", "，死者从此下落不明、杳无音讯", "并使其从此下落不明、杳无音讯")], round_changes
print("PASS: LuaJIT loaded 4 current + 4 baseline catalogs")
print("PASS: exactly 53 WORKSET target-only changes; all other records/fields unchanged")
print("PASS: versus frozen FINAL snapshot, this round changed only f34d093d2a")
print("PASS: ，死者从此下落不明、杳无音讯 -> 并使其从此下落不明、杳无音讯")
'","workdir":"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation","yield_time_ms":30000,"max_output_tokens":12000});
text(r.output);
if (r.exit_code !== 0) text(`exit_code=${r.exit_code}`);
